archetype: Grixis Combat-Triggered Upkeep Multiplier, Monarch Courts & Initiative Value Engine
overview: A Grixis (UBR) Inverted-Triangle upkeep-multiplier deck built around Obeka, Splitter of Seconds. The deck pairs unblockable/haste/double-strike combat enablers (Brotherhood Regalia, Winged Boots, Silent Arbiter, Lizard Blades, and the M13 Upkeep Ring trio) with 26 upkeep and time-counter payoffs (all 6 Grixis Monarch Courts, Rilsa Rael's Initiative/Undercity engine, Extravagant Replication, Mechanized Production, Bonehoard Dracosaur, Twilight Prophet, and Plargg and Nassari). Once Obeka connects in combat around Turn 5-6, she generates 2 to 8+ additional upkeep steps immediately after combat, compounding card advantage, life drain, and token production to close the game within 1 opponent response cycle.

core_strategy: Turns 1-3 (Mana, Haste & Evasion Setup): Deploy 2-mana rocks (Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, Talismans, Nightscape Familiar) and pre-drop a haste or unblockable equipment/aura (Swiftfoot Boots, Lightning Greaves, Ring of Valkas, Brotherhood Regalia, Winged Boots, or Trailblazer's Boots) or suspend early spells (Ancestral Vision, Profane Tutor).

Turns 4-5 (Commander Deployment & First Upkeep Burst): Cast Obeka, Splitter of Seconds with haste or protection backup (Fierce Guardianship, Deflecting Swat, Slip Out the Back) alongside a premier upkeep engine (Rilsa Rael, Kingpin, a Monarch Court, As Foretold, or Bonehoard Dracosaur).

Turns 6-7 (Post-Combat Upkeep Avalanche): Connect with an unblockable or double-striking Obeka to trigger 3-8 additional upkeep steps immediately after combat—completing the entire Undercity dungeon in one turn, draining the table for 18+ life via Court of Ambition / Court of Ire / Creeping Bloodsucker / Twilight Prophet, or reaching 8 artifacts with Mechanized Production.

mulligan_priorities.keep: Hands with 3+ lands covering {U}{B}{R}, at least 1 two-mana ramp piece, and 1 haste/evasion enabler or low-curve upkeep engine.
mulligan_priorities.avoid: 2-land hands without a 2-mana rock (the 35-land baseline can stall on Turn 4 land drops) or top-heavy hands overloaded with 5-7 CMC upkeep payoffs and no evasion for Obeka.

key_tips: Silent Arbiter makes Obeka 100% unblockable because Obeka has native Menace (cannot be blocked except by 2+ creatures) while Silent Arbiter limits blockers to at most 1 creature.

Sequence your M13 Rings (Ring of Valkas, Ring of Xathrid, Ring of Evos Isle) before attaching Shroud equipment (Lightning Greaves or Whispersilk Cloak); Obeka is all three colors (UBR), so every Ring puts a +1/+1 counter on her during every post-combat upkeep.

Alexios, Deimos of Kosmos triggers on EVERY player's upkeep—meaning after Alexios and Obeka attack on your turn, your post-combat extra upkeeps untap Alexios and stack multiple +1/+1 counters on him before passing to the next opponent.

critical: Commander Removal Prior to Combat Damage: Nearly all explosive turns require Obeka to deal combat damage to a player; instant-speed removal or edicts before the combat damage step cut off the extra upkeep chain.

35-Land Baseline Bottleneck & Filter Signet Friction: Running 35 lands with a 4-CMC 3-color commander and equipment equip costs creates occasional Turn 4-5 mana/color stalls (18.8% of seats delayed past Turn 5 in Goldfish testing).
moderate: Shroud Self-Targeting Conflict: Attaching Whispersilk Cloak or Lightning Greaves prevents you from equipping additional Rings, Lizard Blades, or Aqueous Form onto Obeka unless a second creature is available to temporarily hold the Shroud equipment.
Fog / Maze of Ith Effects: Preventing Obeka's combat damage (without destroying her) neutralizes her upkeep trigger for the turn.
minor: Monarch / Initiative Theft by Flying Swarm Decks: If Silent Arbiter is not on the battlefield, evasive token decks can steal the Monarch or Initiative crown before your turn, halving the output of your Courts.

justifications.r1: Runs 10 early mana accelerators (Sol Ring, Arcane Signet, 3 Talismans, 3 Signets, Nightscape Familiar, Replicating Ring) plus explosive upkeep mana engines (As Foretold, Bonehoard Dracosaur, Generous Plunderer, Rousing Refrain). Achieves a Turn 4.7 average commander cast across 80 goldfish seats, slightly tempered by a 35-land baseline.
justifications.r2: Massive compounding card flow once Obeka or the Monarch Courts stick: Bonehoard Dracosaur, Twilight Prophet, Plargg and Nassari, Phyrexian Arena, Indulgent Tormentor, Scrawling Crawler, Ancestral Vision, Inspiring Refrain, and 6 Monarch Courts generate 4-8+ cards per combat connection.
justifications.a1: High functional redundancy across both core pillars: 12 evasion/haste enablers and 26 upkeep/time-counter payoffs ensure consistent pairing, supported by Profane Tutor (which resolves immediately after combat when Obeka generates 2+ upkeeps).
justifications.a2: 86% of goldfish seats reach full Bracket 3 Engine Readiness by Turn <=7 with an average Engine Readiness of Turn 5.1 (37 of 80 seats ready by Turn 3-4).
justifications.p1: Critical threat onset occurs on Turn 6 (Tier B): after deploying a rock/enabler on Turns 2-3, Obeka on Turn 4, and a 4-6 CMC payoff (Court, Dracosaur, Rilsa Rael, Extravagant Replication) on Turn 5, the first decisive multi-upkeep combat burst hits on Turn 5-6.
justifications.p2: High win compactness (1 opponent response cycle, Tier A): a single unblocked or double-striking combat hit with Obeka + a Court/Initiative/Ring engine generates 4-8 upkeeps in one post-combat phase, overwhelming or eliminating the table on the following turn.
justifications.p3: Requires Obeka to attack and deal combat damage to a player (Tier B), telegraphing the engine on the battlefield and giving opponents a combat window to interact.
justifications.i1: Strong Grixis reactive suite featuring free commander stack shields (Fierce Guardianship, Deflecting Swat), efficient 1-2 mana countermagic (An Offer You Can't Refuse, Counterspell, Arcane Denial, Slip Out the Back), spot removal (Terminate, Chaos Warp, Feed the Swarm, Suspended Sentence), and premier sweepers (Toxic Deluge, Blasphemous Act).
justifications.i2: Deploys Silent Arbiter to lock combat down to 1 creature per side alongside discard/life-tax punisher engines (Court of Ambition, Indulgent Tormentor, Scrawling Crawler), with zero hard stax locks or Mass Land Denial.
justifications.s1: Comprehensive multi-layered commander protection: Fierce Guardianship, Deflecting Swat, Slip Out the Back, Winged Boots (Ward 4), Brotherhood Regalia (Ward 2), Swiftfoot Boots (Hexproof), Lightning Greaves (Shroud), Whispersilk Cloak (Shroud), Ring of Evos Isle (Hexproof), and Ring of Xathrid (Regenerate).
justifications.s2: Palace Siege (Khans mode) returns creatures from graveyard to hand on every upkeep and noncreature Courts/Rings persist through creature wipes, though the deck lacks mass reanimation.
justifications.s3: Six Monarch Courts, Paradox Haze, Extravagant Replication, Bonehoard Dracosaur, Skyline Despot, Twilight Prophet, Plargg and Nassari, and Alexios, Deimos of Kosmos accrue compounding value on natural upkeeps even if Obeka is taxed out of the game.
